purpose: Post-evaluation preservation of previously external research tooling. The frozen P0 ingest pipeline (p0/ingest_p0.py) imports the G2-A IR adapter from .work/g2a/ir/, which was never versioned. These copies are byte-identical to the files used during the experiments; nothing was reconstructed retrospectively.
usage: p0/ingest_p0.py (sealed, unmodified) does sys.path.insert(0, REPO/'.work/g2a/ir'). To rerun the pipeline on a fresh clone, redirect that sys.path entry to tools/repro/ — the module names (ir, adapter_docling) are unchanged. The adapter converts Docling JSON to the canonical DocumentIR used by G2-A/P0.
dependencies: stdlib only for these two modules; the full ingest also needs docling output (docling-slim in requirements-lock.txt) and the CNMV PDFs, which are not redistributed.
